title: Nuraghe towers buried as if by a tidal wave
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Nuraghe towers buried as if by a tidal wave, about ancient at Sardinia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they were suddenly submer they were suddenly covered in earth almost like a tidal wave had swept across the island

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, describes the nuraghe, ancient stone towers on the Italian island of Sardinia. He says they were suddenly covered in earth, almost as if a tidal wave had swept across the island. If true, it would point to a sudden disaster in the ancient past.
